newsitem.title: UK: BP/Mobil 60kbpd U.K. Coryton cat cracker down.
newsitem.headline: BP/Mobil 60kbpd U.K. Coryton cat cracker down.

text.p: The BP/Mobil 60,000 barrel per day Coryton catalytic cracker in the U.K. has been shut down for "essential maintenance following technical problems," a BP spokesman said on Friday.
The unit will be down until the middle to end of next week.
"There is a technical problem, but we hope the unit will be up and running at the end of next week," the spokesman said.
The shutdown exacerbates an already tight and bullish gasoline market in Europe and the United States.
Two other refineries in NWE have also suffered problems with their cat crackers at the end of the week.

BP and Texaco's 55,000 bpd Nerefco, Rotterdam unit will be down for a few days because of production problems while one of two cat crackers at Shell's nearby Pernis facility is shutting immediately for a three month maintenance period, a month longer than anticipated.
